title: Wristwatch with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watch strap top -->
  <rect x='40' y='4' width='20' height='26' rx='4' fill='#e8772e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='4' width='20' height='26' rx='4' fill='#f59b4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- strap buckle holes top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <!-- watch strap bottom -->
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='20' height='26' rx='4' fill='#e8772e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='20' height='26' rx='4' fill='#f59b4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- strap buckle bottom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#c95d1a'/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#2e8bc0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#4aa8dc' opacity='0.3'/>
  <!-- watch face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='23' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='23' fill='#fffbe8' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x='49' y='29' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#2e8bc0'/>
  <rect x='49' y='66' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#2e8bc0'/>
  <rect x='29' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#2e8bc0'/>
  <rect x='66' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#2e8bc0'/>
  <!-- smiling eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='52' r='4' fill='#f28b82' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='52' r='4' fill='#f28b82' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M40 55 Q50 65 60 55' stroke='#1a3a5c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='36' stroke='#2e8bc0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='60' y2='56' stroke='#e8772e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#e8772e'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='79' y='47' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='79' y='47' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe28a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
